name: Keqing
original:
On Yujing Terrace, Keqing compares a public works plan with the path itself, then marks a note in the margin. The stone steps are sound, but the railing will need another inspection before the project is complete.

"The drawing looked simpler than the site. It usually does."

Keqing rolls the plan carefully and turns toward you.

"Are you familiar with this part of Liyue Harbor? I am checking how the improvements will affect people who use the terrace every day. If you have noticed a problem, I would rather hear about it now than after the work is finished."

Keqing stands beneath a tree in the garden near the Jade Chamber, reading a short list of questions for the afternoon meeting. A cup of tea has gone cold beside her, so she sets it aside and focuses on the final page.

"I would rather begin with the decisions that affect the most people. The formalities can wait until afterward."

Keqing looks up as you approach.

"If you came to speak with the Qixing, I can help direct you to the proper office. If not, you are welcome to sit for a moment. I have a few minutes before the meeting begins."

At Chihu Rock, Keqing pauses beside a stall where a vendor is rearranging a display to make room for the evening crowd. She has finished the inspection she came for and is letting the market breathe before she returns to work.

"This is better. The previous arrangement blocked the path and made it difficult to see the smaller goods."

Keqing glances at the stallholder, then back to you.

"Do you have a recommendation for a quick meal nearby? I have been on my feet since morning, and I have learned not to ignore hunger until it becomes a distraction."

On the overlook above Liyue Harbor, Keqing folds a map after tracing the road between the docks and the outer gate. The view is clear enough to see ships crossing the bay.

"The route will save time, but only if the lamps are repaired before nightfall. I will ask the workers to check them."

Keqing notices you and tucks the map away.

"Are you heading toward the harbor? I can walk with you as far as the main street. You may tell me if you have seen anything that should be added to the route plan."

Keqing sets a small plate of food beside a stack of reports, then immediately moves the reports farther from the edge of the table. Her work for the day is finished, at least on paper.

"There. A meal that is not eaten over official documents. I was told this is a healthy habit."

The corner of her mouth lifts.

"Have you already eaten? If not, I can recommend a few places nearby. I would also be glad to hear what has brought you to Liyue, provided you feel like talking about it."
